title: TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years
* Work Mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary: (P3/P4)**
We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Overview**
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about scaling Cloud services to join our growing SRE team. The SRE team owns the infrastructure, tooling and automation that Jira and Confluence Cloud runs on, and has a deep understanding of how Atlassian products leverage cloud infrastructure to meet customer reliability expectations.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a technical leader who is aware of current industry trends (particularly those related to reliability). You have experience mentoring and growing team members and love to share your knowledge with others. We'd love it if you brought a deep understanding of modern Cloud infrastructure, programming expertise, operational experience and a desire to change the status quo. We're looking for an engineer who can analyse and help improve our services and processes to get us to an even higher level of reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. You will report directly to the Senior Engineering Manager.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* 5+ years experience operating high-availability, fault-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production: building monitoring, tweaking dashboards, defining alerts, writing runbooks, etc.
* 5+ years of hands on experience with public cloud offerings (at least 1 year experience on GCP).
* Familiarity with Unix / Linux operating systems.
* Strong emphasis to debug, improve code, and automate routine tasks.
* Strong backend engineering experience in one or more prominent languages such as Java, Go or Python.
* Excellent communication skills in written and verbal forms, and an ability to communicate complex technical issues to a range of technical and non-technical audiences (management, peers, clients).
* An ability and desire to mentor and coach engineers

**Qualifications**
**It would be great, but not mandatory if you had:**

* Experience in datastores (RDBMS, time-series-database, NoSql, search, analytics).
* Experience in microservice architecture.
* Experience building web-services and clients using REST/GraphQL.
* Expertise in JVM, Garbage Collection, and Performance Tuning.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement
* Support CDM Operations, Geo Sales Operations, and Data-to-Value teams with issue resolution, data loads, mass data updates, and technical guidance.
* Develop SQL-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Apply deep understanding of CDM business processes and related enterprise systems, including ERP, PLM, CRM, and the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication & Enablement
* Work closely with technology and operations teams to ensure successful, sustainable delivery of CDM systems, including transitions to IT operations.
* Provide regular project and operational updates (weekly/monthly), and confidently brief executive audiences to support informed, proactive decision-making.
* Report risks, issues, and progress to IT leadership, escalating as appropriate.
* Develop, deliver, and support training for CDM operations and key user teams, enabling adoption and effective system usage.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Background:**
**Work History:**

* 5+ years of experience in designing solutions and defining requirements for CDM platforms and complex IT systems, including hands-on experience with databases, SQL, ETL processes, and related data systems..
* Excellent communication skills and customer service skills
* Must have strong problem-solving ability, critical thinking skills, creative/innovative thinking, attention to detail, and previous systems/business analyst experience.
* Must show positive attitude, strong self-motivation, ability to meet deadlines, and ability to determine appropriate sense of urgency.
* Good understanding of software development life cycles.

**Technical Competence:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related field.
* Expertise in Data warehouse and ETL tools like BODS (Business Objects Data Services), DataStage, Business Objects, AWS Aurora and AWS Redshift.
* Must have knowledge in IT Development, Production support or Operations area.
* Extensive working experience in SQL Query or other programming languages.
* Must have knowledge in Microsoft office tools, particularly Excel, VBA and Access.
* Nice to have knowledge of web applications, portals and document management tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of webMethods or any such integration tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of SAP HANA, Microsoft D365, Enovia or similar tools in ERP, CRM and PLM.
* Nice to have knowledge in Power Platform apps, Power BI, Power App, Power Automate/ Flow.
* Experience in project management skills.

**Skills:**

* Oral & Written Communication.
* Strong problem solving, critical thinking
* Ability to be a global team player, communicate and work well in a collaborative environment.
* Be proactive in resolving issues and delivering business solutions.
* Handling Confidential & Sensitive Data & Information.
* Process Facilitation.

* Support business development activities, proposal creation, solution estimations, and pre-sales engagements.

* Deep understanding of enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, data integration, and analytics architectures.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-based analytics and reporting solutions.
* Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong stakeholder and executive management skills.

title: DataNimbus - Data Architect - Databricks
description:
**About DataNimbus**
DataNimbus is an enterprise AI company with deep vertical solutions in financial services and industrial sectors. We build domain-native AI that understands how industries actually operate, not just how data flows through them. Our solutions are outcome-driven and industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets perform, and how businesses grow.
  
  
**What Would Help Make Your Case**

* 8+ years in data engineering or data platforms, including 4+ years hands-on with Databricks in production.
* 2+ years as architect or technical lead, owning design decisions for a platform or program.
* Led at least 2 end-to-end migrations to Databricks from legacy platforms (e.g. Hadoop, Teradata, Oracle, Informatica, Synapse, Snowflake), each at TB scale or above.
* Led the design and delivery of at least 2 end-to-end Databricks lakehouse implementations, covering medallion architecture, data modeling, batch and streaming, Unity Catalog governance, and non-functional requirements.
* Owned technical delivery of at least 1 Databricks program (team of 4+, 6+ months): scope, estimates, technical risks and timelines.

description:

Full-time
  
  
Role Overview

The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise in
**SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebates, settlements, and accruals—complemented by strong domain knowledge in
**Sales & Distribution (SD)**
and
**Pricing**
. In this role, you will lead enhancement deliveries, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support to ensure seamless business operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enhancements, Projects & Business Analysis
* Enhancement Delivery: Lead and deliver enhancements in CCM processes, including designing new contract types, complex settlement logic, and business-specific rebate models.
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement settings, and seamless integration points with financial modules.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with ABAP/technical teams during custom development, code walk-throughs, unit testing, and deployment.
* Testing & Deployment: Drive System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring defect-free releases into production environments.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.
* Application Support & Maintenance (L2/L3)
* Production Support: Provide high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM processes, ensuring strict SLA adherence and minimal operational disruption.
* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.
* Cross-Module Integration & Governance
* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.
* Change Governance: Strictly adhere to transport management, release governance, and change management procedures (CAB approvals) for all system changes.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate functional design documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for peer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).
* SAP SD & Pricing: Strong expertise in SD core processes (O2C), pricing procedures, condition technique, access sequences, and condition types.
* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

Experience & Education
  
  

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* S/4HANA Exposure: Hands-on experience operating in S/4HANA environments is mandatory.
* Certifications (Preferred): SAP Certified Application Associate – S/4HANA Sales or SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management.

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting abilities.
* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both business key users and technical developers.
* Leadership: Ability to independently manage tasks, mentor junior support team members, and drive delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder Management: Experienced in facilitating workshops, prioritizing backlog items, and managing business user expectations during critical issue resolution.

title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise

title: Salesforce Service Cloud Administrator
description:
**Why join Safeguard Global?**
👀
  
  
We want to help you
**“work in any way**
” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀
  
  
Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first — they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a
**job that works for you. ✅**
**The role in a nutshell:**
We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to support the management and ongoing optimization of Safeguard Global’s Salesforce Service Cloud platform. Reporting to the Senior Salesforce Administrator, this role will help maintain the day-to-day operations of Service Cloud, support system enhancements, and assist with user requests and troubleshooting. The Salesforce Administrator will work closely with support and operations teams to translate business needs into platform configurations, automation, and reporting capabilities that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. While the primary focus of this role is Service Cloud, the administrator should maintain a general awareness of Sales Cloud functionality to ensure alignment across the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will also support the adoption of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, helping implement automation and intelligent service workflows that enhance support operations and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
**How you will make a difference:**

* Support the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring system stability, usability, and performance.
* Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to implement system enhancements and platform improvements.
* Configure and maintain Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and automation flows.
* Assist with user management, including account setup, permissions, and role-based access controls.
* Provide frontline support for Salesforce users by troubleshooting issues and responding to support requests.
* Collaborate with operations and support teams to gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with maintaining data quality and integrity through monitoring, data cleanup, and governance practices.
* Support testing, validation, and deployment of Salesforce updates and new features.
* Assist with the configuration and monitoring of AI-powered capabilities such as Agentforce agents and service automation workflows.
* Collaborate with technical teams to define, test, monitor, and troubleshoot MuleSoft integrations that enable reliable data exchange and workflow synchronization between Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira, Workday, and other business platforms
* Document system configurations, processes, and user guides to support internal knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of Sales Cloud processes and data structures to ensure alignment across the Salesforce platform.

**What will give you an advantage:**

* 3+ years of experience working with Salesforce
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM 201) preferred
* Experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud environments.
* Knowledge of day to day workings in AWS Telephony platform for inbound and outbound contact handling
* Working knowledge of MuleSoft integration capabilities, connectors, APIs, authentication, data mapping, and flow monitoring to support integrations between Salesforce Service Cloud and platforms such as Jira and Workday
* Basic familiarity with Sales Cloud concepts and objects to maintain cross-platform awareness.
* Experience configuring Salesforce features such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Exposure to Salesforce Flow or automation tools is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce or Einstein AI
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical configurations
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

**Who we are and what we do:**
  
  
Safeguard Global is…global!
**We enable global expansion without the risk**
by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎
  
  
**Our Global Benefits**
:
  
  

* 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
* 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family
* 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
* 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
* ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
* ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.

🌐

description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers

Required

* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake

Nice to have

* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale

title: Servicenow-Application Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Salesforce Technical Manager - Core Data
description:
**Description**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team.
  
  
In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a Data Architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s platform and core data fundamentals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a data/technical architect) on billable projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants/Architects

+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end-to-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi-org, multi-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Industries Cloud and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality customer solutions.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, App Builder, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.
